headline: DIC India Limited files insolvency claim against Attharv Sai FlexiPack Private Limited
sum: DIC India Limited has filed a claim against Attharv Sai FlexiPack Private Limited with the Interim Resolution Professional, triggering formal IBC insolvency proceedings against the debtor company.
detail: DIC India Limited, a listed entity on NSE, has formally filed a claim with the Interim Resolution Professional (IRP) appointed for Attharv Sai FlexiPack Private Limited, likely a supplier or trade creditor relationship. The filing triggers mandatory disclosure under SEBI Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements (LODR) Regulation 30, as it constitutes a material event affecting DIC's financials or stakeholder interests. The company's statutory obligation to notify the exchange within two business days of the event demonstrates IBC proceedings are now formally initiated, and DIC's claim will be subject to the IRP's adjudication under IBC sections 21–23.
